557717000:struggling.h: D.Bojorquez's Rating Says 86. His Field Goal Misses Say Otherwise
557717000:struggling.d: Making only 6 of 12 field goals is a problem for a ranked team. [[p:557717000|D.Bojorquez]] may have to fend off competition this offseason, and the staff reportedly isn't comfortable going into next year on faith.

quote.text: Nobody doubts the leg. It's the misses that people remember in close games, and that's what the staff keeps coming back to.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557715200:struggling.h: Florida Is Weighing a Quarterback Change as C.Keener's Production Lags
557715200:struggling.d: [[p:557715200|C.Keener]] threw 12 touchdowns against 11 interceptions on 248-of-423 passing for 3153 yards. That's a 125.4 rating, and it has [[t:832438308|Florida]] debating whether an 87-overall quarterback is still the answer.

quote.text: The ratings are good. The results are what people are talking about, and the conversations aren't quiet anymore.
quote.by: a source close to the program

carousel:H0ldStillPlease:move:832438379:.h: Harrell leaves East Carolina for Stanford and a No. 25 ranking
carousel:H0ldStillPlease:move:832438379:.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] goes from a 19-19 run at [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] to a Stanford program that starts the year ranked No. 25. Players on both rosters are already deciding whether to stay.

quote.text: He sold the Stanford staff on a clean slate. Whether the roster buys it is another question.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

rec:season:receivingYards:557727604.h: M.Harris Passes Insley, Owns the Single-Season Receiving Record
rec:season:receivingYards:557727604.d: [[p:557727604|M.Harris]] now has 2,087 receiving yards. That is past the 2,060 that stood as the real-life FBS mark, set by Trevor Insley of Nevada in 1999. Expect his phone to keep ringing in the portal.

quote.text: Every defense knows where he's going. It doesn't matter.
quote.by: a rival defensive staffer

831914916:4th:832438284.h: Boise State Goes for It Four Times, Gets Burned by Ohio State
831914916:4th:832438284.d: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] converted two of four fourth-down tries against [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] and handed the ball back on downs twice. The analytics crowd will defend it. Boosters who left early were not buying it.

quote.text: You can be aggressive and still have a punter. Nobody on that sideline wanted to hear that, though.
quote.by: a person close to the Boise State program

561124414battle.h: Penn State's Thin Backfield Could Be Its Best Pitch to J. Davis
561124414battle.d: Arkansas holds a slight lead for [[r:561124414|J. Davis]], with Florida still in the mix. His dealbreaker is playing time, and [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has one returning running back. A source says the Nittany Lions staff has leaned hard on that.

quote.text: He wants to see the field as a freshman. Penn State can show him a depth chart and say, 'Look.'
quote.by: a source close to the recruiting process

561119710battle.h: Notre Dame's Pro Pipeline Gives It a Shot With J. Droogsma
561119710battle.d: [[t:832438277|Arizona State]] leads for four-star receiver [[r:561119710|J. Droogsma]], but [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] is closing on pro potential, his dealbreaker. The Irish have sent five receivers to the draft in four years. Minnesota is hanging around.

quote.text: He keeps asking about the draft. Notre Dame keeps handing him names.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

561122612battle.h: Gillikin Wants a Title Shot, and Nebraska Is Selling One
561122612battle.d: Indiana still leads for [[r:561122612|B. Gillikin]], but [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] is gaining because he wants a contender. The Huskers grade out an A- there. Florida State is still lurking.

quote.text: Every visit, he asks the same thing: can I win a ring here?
quote.by: a high school coach familiar with the process

561125824commit.h: Texas Tech Lands Four-Star Linebacker M. Chukwurah on Title Pitch
561125824commit.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] earned an A+ for championship contention, and [[r:561125824|M. Chukwurah]] wanted a shot at a title. The Red Raiders also rank 6th nationally in pro potential at linebacker, with a first-round pick in the last four years.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.
quote.by: M. Chukwurah

561124482commit.h: D. Lowe Picks Notre Dame Over Michigan and Miami
561124482commit.d: [[r:561124482|D. Lowe]] chose [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] because of the coaching staff, which earned an A+ for prestige. The Irish also rank 5th nationally in pro potential at offensive line. [[t:832438339|Michigan]] and [[t:832438337|Miami]] came up short.

quote.text: You trust the guys who've done it. This staff has done it.
quote.by: D. Lowe

561123302commit.h: TCU Lands Four-Star Receiver J. Fabuluje, Who Says He Wants Rings
561123302commit.d: [[r:561123302|J. Fabuluje]] picked [[t:832438381|TCU]] after seeing an A-grade title contender whose offense ranks 15th in receptions with 229. For a playmaking receiver, that is a good setup.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.
quote.by: J. Fabuluje

561119293commit.h: Rivalry Win Over Auburn Seals It: K. Bacon Picks Alabama
561119293commit.d: [[r:561119293|K. Bacon]] chose [[t:832438274|Alabama]] over [[t:832438339|Michigan]] and [[t:832438278|Arkansas]]. He watched Alabama's 50-31 rivalry win over [[t:832438281|Auburn]] from the stands, and a source says the visit effectively closed it.

quote.text: That win over Auburn? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.
quote.by: K. Bacon

557713038:stayed:2029.h: B.Lyle Was Supposed to Leave Ohio State. He Stayed
557713038:stayed:2029.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] spent two weeks on Portal Watch, buried on the depth chart and about to get expensive after a rating jump. Now the portal is open and he is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. A source says the staff pushed hard to keep him.

quote.text: That one was closer than people think.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

557712701:stayed:2029.h: R.Gado Stays at Ohio State Despite Depth Chart Noise
557712701:stayed:2029.d: [[p:557712701|R.Gado]] spent two weeks on Portal Watch, stuck on the depth chart. He is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the portal open. Tuddy_roosevelt still has to show him a clearer path to playing time.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557723757:stayed:2029.h: K.Bing Stays at Ohio State, and the Pay Question Stays Too
557723757:stayed:2029.d: [[p:557723757|K.Bing]] was on Portal Watch for a week because he is underpaid for his rating. He did not enter the portal, and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] kept him for now. A raise could still come up.

quote.text: He's happy. But he knows his number, and he'd like the staff to know it too.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

557724533:stayed:2029.h: K.Gebhardt Skips the Portal at Ohio State
557724533:stayed:2029.d: [[p:557724533|K.Gebhardt]] spent a week on Portal Watch as underpaid for his rating. The portal is open and he is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster, even as teammates head out.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557724852:stayed:2029.h: Army Keeps R.Hopkins After Money Talks
557724852:stayed:2029.d: Portal Watch had [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]] as a likely departure. He played on a losing team and drew criticism for his numbers. [[t:832438280|Army]] bumped his NIL from 205K to 300K, and he is still on the roster.

quote.text: Honestly, I thought he was gone. The staff went to work on him.
quote.by: a team source

557724319:stayed:2029.h: A.Gafford Stays at Penn State After Rating Jump
557724319:stayed:2029.d: [[p:557724319|A.Gafford]] was on Portal Watch because his rating jump made him expensive. With the portal open, he is still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster. A source says agerm40's staff kept him in the loop.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the Penn State program

557711879:stayed:2029.h: J.Blue Is Still an Ohio State Buckeye
557711879:stayed:2029.d: Portal Watch flagged [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] for a week because his rating jump was about to make him expensive. He is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the portal open.

quote.text: Nothing changed on our end. He's been solid all offseason.
quote.by: a person close to the Ohio State program

557713883:stayed:2029.h: Ohio State Holds Onto S.Wisne as Teammates Depart
557713883:stayed:2029.d: [[p:557713883|S.Wisne]] was on Portal Watch for a week as a rising-rating, rising-cost player. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] kept him off the portal list. Several teammates were not so lucky.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

557719002:stayed:2029.h: N.Pullard Stays at Penn State Despite Scheme Concerns
557719002:stayed:2029.d: Portal Watch flagged [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] for a week as a bad fit for the scheme. He is still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster, a small win for agerm40 while two four-stars did leave.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557713201:stayed:2029.h: M.Carver Stays at Penn State After a Week on the Watch
557713201:stayed:2029.d: [[p:557713201|M.Carver]] was on Portal Watch because of a scheme fit concern. The portal is open and he remains on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster, so the secondary rebuild has a little more to work with.

quote.text: There were conversations. He's comfortable with where it landed.
quote.by: a source close to the Penn State program

832438379:exodus:2029.h: Stanford Loses 11 to the Portal as Harrell Arrives
832438379:exodus:2029.d: Eleven players entered the portal from [[t:832438379|Stanford]]. That includes tackles Devon Todia and Marquez Lett and receiver Jalen Gibbs. None are four-stars or better, but the new coaching change is the obvious backdrop.

quote.text: Some guys wanted to see what the new staff looked like. Others didn't wait.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

832438359:exodus:2029.h: Ohio State Loses Four, Including Three Blue-Chip Defenders
832438359:exodus:2029.d: Safety Cortez Gaydosh, cornerback Daniel Wilkes and linebacker Layne Wayne are among four players to leave [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Tuddy_roosevelt has to replace three four- or five-star players, mostly on defense.

quote.text: That's a lot of snaps walking out the door in one phase.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

832438366:exodus:2029.h: Penn State Loses Tackle Truman and Edge Durbin to the Portal
832438366:exodus:2029.d: Four-star tackle Konrad Truman and four-star edge rusher Tory Durbin are on the way out of [[t:832438366|Penn State]]. agerm40 now has to rebuild the lines before the next window closes.

quote.text: You lose two guys up front like that, and the recruiting pitch has to change.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557723242:gone:2029.h: J.Slay Leaves Bowling Green After a Week on the Watch List
557723242:gone:2029.d: TD Wire flagged [[p:557723242|J.Slay]] as underpaid for his rating. He is now in the portal, leaving a hole at [[t:832438286|Bowling Green]]. Mid-major budgets rarely beat this kind of gap.

557727223:gone:2029.h: T.Crethers Hits the Portal, Leaving Colorado With a Hole
557727223:gone:2029.d: [[p:557727223|T.Crethers]] spent a week on Portal Watch, under fire for his numbers. He is now in the transfer portal, and [[t:832438295|Colorado]] has to find a replacement.

557715676:gone:2029.h: K.Largent Leaves Miami for the Portal
557715676:gone:2029.d: Portal Watch flagged [[p:557715676|K.Largent]] for a week because he was under fire for his numbers. He is now gone from [[t:832438337|Miami]], and the production questions followed him out.

557728277:gone:2029.h: D.Peters Exits Army, a Day After the Hopkins Win
557728277:gone:2029.d: [[p:557728277|D.Peters]] hit the portal after a week on the watch list for under-the-radar numbers. [[t:832438280|Army]] kept R.Hopkins but lost Peters, a mixed result for the staff.

557716595:gone:2029.h: G.Lovelace Enters the Portal, Leaving Florida Thin
557716595:gone:2029.d: [[p:557716595|G.Lovelace]] spent a week on Portal Watch, under fire for his numbers. He is now in the portal, leaving [[t:832438308|Florida]] with a hole to fill.

557727240:underpaid.h: Rival Collectives Circle Oregon's J.Curtis, a 93-Overall QB Making Nothing
557727240:underpaid.d: [[p:557727240|J.Curtis]] is a 93-overall quarterback with no NIL money, while similar players earn around 260K. Collectives are circling. [[t:832438364|Oregon]] has deep pockets, 9th nationally, which may be its best defense.

quote.text: Everybody knows what he's worth. It's a matter of who's willing to say it first.
quote.by: a rival collective source

557724658:underpaid.h: N.Grubbs Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
557724658:underpaid.d: [[p:557724658|N.Grubbs]], a 91-overall quarterback, makes nothing in NIL while peers earn around 235K. Collectives know the gap closes fast in the portal.

quote.text: There's no way he stays at zero. Somebody's going to fix that.
quote.by: a source familiar with his situation

557726587:underpaid.h: A.Noriega's Pay Gap Has Quarterback-Needy Contenders Lining Up, Penn State Included
557726587:underpaid.d: [[p:557726587|A.Noriega]] is a 92-overall quarterback making 115K, while comparable passers get around 260K. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] is being mentioned as a landing spot, and the market will probably correct itself fast.

quote.text: A guy rated that high at that position isn't staying at that number once the window opens. Somebody will call, and somebody will pay.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557726991:underpaid.h: D.Berymon Is Playing for Free at Texas. That Won't Last
557726991:underpaid.d: [[p:557726991|D.Berymon]] is a 91-overall defensive tackle with no NIL deal, though comparable players get around 220K. [[t:832438384|Texas]] has the 10th-deepest NIL pockets in the country, so it has room to fix this before somebody else tries.

quote.text: You don't leave a guy like that unpaid and expect nobody to notice. Everybody has noticed.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557716293:sinking.h: G.Priester Is Too Good for a 4-8 Minnesota Team, and Everyone Knows It
557716293:sinking.d: [[p:557716293|G.Priester]] is a 92-overall junior receiver stuck on a losing team. Contenders have already circled his name, and Minnesota may have a hard time convincing him that next year looks different.

quote.text: He's a first-call guy. Every offense in the country with a hole at receiver has his number saved.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

557726463:struggling.h: C.Diabate Was Supposed to Be a Star. Now He Has to Earn His Job
557726463:struggling.d: [[p:557726463|C.Diabate]] had 17 catches for 276 yards in 14 games, which isn't enough for an 85-overall receiver on a ranked team. He'll go into camp fighting for his spot, and younger receivers are reportedly pushing him.

quote.text: Nobody is handing him anything this summer. He has to show he's the guy everyone thought he was.
quote.by: a source close to the program

831914385:upset.h: No. 1 Ohio State falls at Nebraska, and the playoff picture cracks on opening week
831914385:upset.d: [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] arrived as the nation's top team and left [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] with a loss it can't hide from. The Huskers outgained the Buckeyes 491 to 448. Tuddy_roosevelt now has to explain how his defense got outworked.

quote.text: We thought we were ready. We weren't ready for how physical they'd be.
quote.by: an Ohio State player, per a source close to the program

831914385:4th:832438348.h: Nebraska went for it on fourth down, and Ohio State never recovered
831914385:4th:832438348.d: The Huskers kept the punter on the bench in a 28-25 win over [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] and converted 3 of 4 tries. Each conversion drained more life from the Buckeyes' defense. Sideline chatter says that group was gassed by the end.

quote.text: Every time they stayed out there you could see our guys looking at each other.
quote.by: an Ohio State defender, per a source close to the program

561119626battle.h: Texas holds the edge for five-star corner Wilds, but TCU is pushing
561119626battle.d: [[t:832438384|Texas]] has the slight lead for [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]], who says he wants a championship contender. [[t:832438381|TCU]] is pitching hard that it is one, and Ole Miss is hanging around. Someone's heart gets broken on signing day.

quote.text: He keeps asking one question: who's actually going to win it all? That's the whole recruitment.
quote.by: a person close to Wilds

561121675battle.h: Missouri barely ahead of Tennessee for Favre, and TCU hasn't gone away
561121675battle.d: [[r:561121675|I. Favre]] cares about conference prestige, and that has kept [[t:832438344|Missouri]] and [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] in a tight race. [[t:832438381|TCU]] is lurking. Both leaders are expected to empty the playbook this week.

quote.text: He wants to play on Saturdays that matter. The league has to sell itself.
quote.by: Favre's high school coach

561125724battle.h: Georgia leads for five-star Coburn, but Florida State has the home-field card
561125724battle.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] has the lead for [[r:561125724|P. Coburn]], but proximity to home is his dealbreaker. That is where [[t:832438310|Florida State]] could swing it. Miami is lurking and Georgia's staff is nervous.

quote.text: His family wants to see him play down the road. That matters more than people think.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561121494battle.h: Tennessee leads Clemson for Yeast, but Alabama is crashing the party
561121494battle.d: [[r:561121494|W. Yeast]] wants a clear path to playing time. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has the edge on that front, [[t:832438293|Clemson]] isn't backing off, and Alabama is still lurking.

quote.text: Show him the depth chart, show him the snaps. That's what he's asking every staff.
quote.by: a person close to Yeast

561120536battle.h: Tennessee's national brand could be the tiebreaker for five-star Longo
561120536battle.d: [[r:561120536|C. Longo]] wants the biggest stage. [[t:832438344|Missouri]] and [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] are even, but Tennessee's brand exposure grades out as elite. Texas is lurking, and official visits could settle it.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to the national spotlight. Tennessee checks that box better than anyone.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561121938battle.h: Texas Holds Edge for Simonson, but Tennessee and USC Aren't Going Away
561121938battle.d: [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]] has Texas in front, Tennessee close behind and USC still in the picture. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker, and the Longhorns are benefiting from it. One more big week could settle it.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to the league he'll be playing in. That's the first thing he brings up every time we talk.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

557717923:breakout.h: Sophomore Naanee's breakout leaves East Carolina with a pricey problem
557717923:breakout.d: [[p:557717923|L.Naanee]] is up 13 points to 78 overall and earning nothing in NIL. With a coaching change at [[t:832438301|East Carolina]], rival collectives are already taking notice.

quote.text: A new staff, a big jump, and no money. Calls are going to start coming.
quote.by: a rival collective source

557711974:breakout.h: Ball State freshman Gastineau is a bigger name than anyone budgeted for
557711974:breakout.d: [[p:557711974|J.Gastineau]], a freshman corner, jumped 13 points to 76 overall and earns nothing in NIL. [[t:832438282|Ball State]] ranks 96th in NIL spending, so a bidding war is a losing proposition.

quote.text: Bigger programs have noticed him. Ball State can't match that kind of money.
quote.by: a portal-watching source

557714494:breakout.h: Baylor receiver Fuller is getting paid like a role player and playing like a star
557714494:breakout.d: [[p:557714494|M.Fuller]] is up 12 points to 82 overall and earning nothing in NIL. Expect collectives to circle the sophomore, and [[t:832438283|Baylor]] has little time to fix it.

quote.text: He's earning nothing, and everyone knows it. That changes fast.
quote.by: a source familiar with Baylor's roster

557720960:breakout.h: Kennesaw State freshman Levine is a star on a small-budget team
557720960:breakout.d: [[p:557720960|P.Levine]] is up 12 points to 82 overall, and his NIL number is still zero. [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]] ranks 113th in NIL spending, so keeping him will be hard.

quote.text: Players like that don't stay on small-school money for long.
quote.by: a rival recruiting coordinator

557724098:breakout.h: Florida State's Shor is up 11 points, and he knows his worth
557724098:breakout.d: [[p:557724098|J.Shor]], a freshman receiver, jumped 11 points to 80 overall and earns nothing in NIL. Keeping him will cost [[t:832438310|Florida State]], which has plenty of other holes.

quote.text: He's not going to ask. Other schools will do it for him.
quote.by: a person close to the program

557719266:underpaid.h: Tennessee has one of the cheapest 89-rated guards in the sport
557719266:underpaid.d: [[p:557719266|L.Trueblood]] is making nothing in NIL while players at his position and rating command around 190K. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]'s deep NIL pockets help, but staffs elsewhere have noticed.

quote.text: You don't find 89 guards at that price. Someone will pay him.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557712567:fit.h: Carraway may not want to stay in a Stanford pass defense that struggles
557712567:fit.d: [[p:557712567|D.Carraway]] is an 84-overall hybrid safety on a [[t:832438379|Stanford]] defense ranked 135th of 138 against the pass. New coach Harrell has a talent to keep on his hands.

quote.text: He's a good player stuck in a bad system. That's a recipe for the portal.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

557716795:fit.h: Penn State's Stockton is a running back to watch if the ground game doesn't improve
557716795:fit.d: [[p:557716795|I.Stockton]] is an 81-overall contact seeker in a Penn State system that ranks 122nd of 138 in rushing. agerm40 needs to fix the run game or risk losing him.

quote.text: He wants a system that actually runs the ball. Right now it's not that.
quote.by: a source close to the Penn State program

557714489:underpaid.h: B.Bouye Is an 87-Overall Back With No NIL Deal. Is SMU the Answer?
557714489:underpaid.d: [[p:557714489|B.Bouye]] has no NIL money, while running backs at his level get around 85K. Collectives are lining up, and [[t:832438375|SMU]] is a name coming up in the chatter. Running backs with this production don't stay unpaid for long once the portal opens.

quote.text: A back like that doesn't sit on the market. The first serious offer is probably the one he takes.
quote.by: a portal-focused agent

557726531:fit.h: Florida State's pass defense could push top safety Page out the door
557726531:fit.d: [[p:557726531|T.Page]] is an 88-overall coverage safety on a [[t:832438310|Florida State]] defense ranked 136th of 138 against the pass. Good players don't stay in bad systems.

quote.text: He knows he's too good for this. The question is who calls first.
quote.by: a source close to the Florida State program

557719942:underpaid.h: Melvin is playing like a star at tackle and getting paid like a backup
557719942:underpaid.d: [[p:557719942|J.Melvin]] is an 84-overall tackle making 30K, while players at his position and rating command around 85K. That gap tends to close in the portal.

quote.text: Linemen like that don't stay underpaid. Someone will fix it.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557712320:underpaid.h: Georgia could be the school to cash in on cornerback Maddox
557712320:underpaid.d: [[p:557712320|K.Maddox]] is an 84-overall corner making nothing in NIL, while players like him command around 50K. [[t:832438312|Georgia]]'s deep pockets make it a natural suitor, but it won't be alone.

quote.text: Georgia has the money and the need. He's on their board.
quote.by: a source familiar with the process

557719687:underpaid.h: Texas Receiver T.Bada Is Producing Like a Star and Earning Nothing
557719687:underpaid.d: [[p:557719687|T.Bada]] is an 87-overall receiver with no NIL deal, while comparable receivers get around 90K. [[t:832438384|Texas]] has one of the deepest collectives in the country, but rivals are already calling.

quote.text: Everyone knows what he's worth. The only question is whether Texas fixes it before somebody else does.
quote.by: a rival collective staffer

557727130:underpaid.h: E.Udoh Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
557727130:underpaid.d: [[p:557727130|E.Udoh]] is an 88-overall receiver with no NIL money, while receivers at his level get around 105K. Collectives know the gap well, and one source says he has already heard from several of them.

quote.text: He's not complaining, but he knows the market. His phone isn't quiet.
quote.by: a person familiar with his situation
